name: Omni Nashville Hotel
positioning: A 21-story downtown Nashville hotel connected to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, with a heated rooftop pool and a full-service spa
best_for: Music lovers who want to stay next to the Country Music Hall of Fame, near Broadway and the Ryman
Travelers who want a rooftop pool and a full-service spa in the middle of downtown

facts.text: Omni Nashville Hotel is in downtown Nashville and is connected to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum.
The hotel is near Broadway, with convenient access to Ryman Auditorium, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena and the Johnny Cash Museum.
The Ryman Auditorium is about half a mile from the hotel.
The hotel is a 21-story building attached to the Music City Center.
The hotel has a heated rooftop pool.
The full-service Mokara Spa offers a full suite of services, in addition to yoga classes.
Rooms use dark colors, bold patterns and luxe materials.
Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of downtown Nashville.
Suites have dedicated living spaces and a separate king bedroom.
Kitchen Notes serves traditional southern dishes and home-cooked meals, including a biscuit bar.
The hotel is 8 miles, approximately 20 minutes, from Nashville International Airport.
The hotel is pet friendly for pets under 25 pounds, with a one-time non-refundable pet fee.

highlights.text: The hotel is connected to the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum.
The Johnny Cash Museum Personal Tour is an Omni Signature Experience that starts with breakfast alongside the museum's curator.
The heated rooftop pool is only available to Omni guests.
Suites have soaking tubs overlooking the city.
Premier rooms or suites on floors 14 and above have views of downtown and the city skyline.

considerations.text: The hotel is attached to the Music City Center and is popular with convention and trade show attendees.
Self-parking and valet parking are available with a nightly charge.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise levels.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Omni Nashville Hotel
